immutable_rules.portable: C++23 compiler auto-vectorization only; no architecture code or intrinsics.
immutable_rules.rate: Identical PCM and harness; same actual bitrate within1% pairwise. Aim for unchanged nominal targets; never credit fewer bits or padding.

gating_reference: Pinned official51bd built from Source with same compiler suite/applicable flags/machine and0 architecture sources/ISA flags/RTCD definitions; normal auto-vectorization retained.

informational_reference.scope: Stock SIMD official; report separately, do not gate.

CPU_clock.resolution: OS accounting may be tick-granular; official-only precision pilots are retained, unscored.

pinning: Verify process affinity mask1, current thread affinity mask1 and actual processor group; ABOVE_NORMAL priority; same machine/group/core for paired runs. Never pause peers.

precision_pilot.lane: Official only after Root config/protocol commit
precision_pilot.update: If observed_ms is zero, double N. Otherwise if under2000ms, N=max(N+1,ceil(N*2250/observed_ms)); cap512 and report blocker if minimum cannot be attained. Retain every pilot. First N reaching minimum becomes one common batch count for both codecs.
precision_pilot.freeze: Numeric counts, encoder states, frames/calls/samples, no resets/flush, input/source/harness identities saved before FIRST timing scope. No per-codec normalization or loop count change.

timing_runs.interleave: Pair codecs for each case, alternate first codec each repetition, rotate case order between repetitions.
timing_runs.state: Precreate fresh independent encoder states for each clip outside CPU clock; equal batch count and exact same complete PCM clip both codecs.
timing_runs.timed_work: Same whole encode loop and return checks/packet-byte accumulation; packet capacity1500B; no allocation/getters/logging/decode/hash/flush/reset inside clock.
timing_runs.precision_failure: Keep raw result and flag; never discard for favorable median. Freeze any necessary complete retrial as a new scope.
timing_runs.under5percent: Any CPU delta under5% requires at least one full independent matched15-per-codec retrial before accepting or rejecting; retain both series.

speed_gate: Per-config unrounded median current encode CPU strictly below scalar official; all17 must pass. Equality fails.
scaling_gate: AUDIO256k median CPU minus AUDIO16k median CPU strictly below scalar official absolute difference; relative growth is report-only.

quality.coverage: All498 matrix+806 published configurations, plus existing FEC standard18/strict18, DTX, RAW/denoiser/state/continuation/ENV/rate/wire predicates. No cuts.
quality.tolerance: Per exact configuration/metric max-min across3 official-only independent self invocations, frozen before ours scoring; zero variance gives zero tolerance.
quality.scoring: Preserve every raw field, prior-relative decline and failure; no metric majority, incompatible averaging or hidden losses.

size_gate.goal: Binary size strictly below350000 bytes; each patch reports stripped size.
artifacts: Normal public full-codec Host COFF opus_codec.o
Normal public full-codec Android ELF opus_codec.o
size_gate.source_scope: Whole Source269 encoder+decoder/public C ABI; no namespace-prefix alias build or function/feature subset.
size_gate.strip_recipe: Matching GNU/LLVM strip --strip-unneeded -o distinct_output.o normal_public_input.o; retain relocations and all externally defined public symbols.
size_gate.measurement: Actual stripped file byte length, separately per normal Host/Android target; old allocated text/data/BSS totals remain historical separate quantities.
size_gate.proof: Compare public defined symbols before/after and complete compiler/image flags; link stripped object with unchanged normal toolchain and real API caller. Link-check driver is excluded from object size.
size_gate.forbidden: No tiny test executable, omitted decoder/features, GC/LTO/Os/native/new flags, or allocated-section total relabeled as file bytes.

provenance: BEFORE_FIRST per image/scope binds exact Source/header/objects/library/input/cwd/options/compiler/version/full argv/flags/harness and original clocks. Later rebuilds cannot rescue chronology.
execution: One outer SHARED nonnested process lease; persist exact owned controller/child PIDs and command/started/completed receipts.
authority: Root commits and publishes; this protocol is a new baseline epoch, not a retag of historical measurements.
